user.title: Yeelight provisioning
user.description: Home Assistant will use this Wi-Fi interface to join the access point of bulbs in pairing mode and hand them the network below. The interface should be dedicated to this.

data.ssid: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network for the bulbs

confirm.title: Provision {ap}
confirm.description: The bulb will join **{ssid}**, then be added to the Yeelight integration.

progress.provision: Joining access point {ap}, sending the {ssid} credentials, then waiting for the bulb on the home network. This can take up to 2 minutes.

error.no_net_admin: Home Assistant is not allowed to drive Wi-Fi: add the NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW capabilities to the container, then recreate it.
error.wifi_error: The Wi-Fi interface does not respond (see the log).

abort.already_in_progress: Provisioning already in progress for this bulb.
abort.no_wireless_interface: No Wi-Fi interface on the host.
abort.hub_missing: Set up the Yeelight Provision integration first.
abort.hub_not_loaded: The Yeelight Provision integration is not loaded.
abort.no_bulbs_found: No bulb in pairing mode. Reset the bulb (5 cycles on 2 s / off 2 s, until it cycles colours) and retry near the host.
abort.wifi_error: The Wi-Fi interface does not respond (see the log).
abort.no_net_admin: Home Assistant is not allowed to drive Wi-Fi: add the NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW capabilities to the container.
abort.connect_failed: Could not join the bulb access point (too far?).
abort.no_response: The bulb does not answer miIO on its access point.
abort.token_hidden: The bulb is already paired and no longer reveals its token. Reset it (5 cycles of 2 s) and retry.
abort.router_refused: The bulb refused the Wi-Fi credentials (see the log).
abort.provisioned: {model} bulb joined {ssid} ({host}) and was added to the Yeelight integration.
abort.provisioned_already_configured: {model} bulb joined {ssid} ({host}). It was already in the Yeelight integration, which updates its address on its own.
abort.provisioned_not_added: {model} bulb joined {ssid} ({host}), but the Yeelight integration could not add it: add it manually.
abort.provisioned_not_found: Credentials sent to the {model} bulb (id {device_id}), but it did not show up on {ssid} within 2 minutes. Check the password and that the network is 2.4 GHz.
